office_prefix_witness.scope: Only the office/file prefix A6S is compared. The reference tails are different and must not be equated.

conditional_office_prefix_assumptions: The p165, p173 and p200 Corcovado reports use the same stable Marineamt office/file prefix A6S.
The earlier observed unknown-prefix pairs are correctly copied and the later spelled-out SECHS denotes that same prefix component.
